observation.title: Joe Cabot's Finger on the Rat
observation.text: Joe Cabot strides into the mortuary warehouse like an aging king whose court has rotted, declares Mr. Blue dead, and levels his snub-nose revolver directly at bleeding Mr. Orange. Joe says the kid is a cop, one hundred percent certain, and tells White to step clear. Every breath inside the shuttered mortuary smells of cordite, stale coffee, and drying arterial blood, forcing each survivor to weigh professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold out the crew.

actions.text: Draw on Joe, swear Orange is solid, hold your nerve

Confront Orange directly with the rehearsed commode story tell

Inside the gunpowder haze, every lie told since breakfast at Uncle Bob's Pancake House comes due over a briefcase of stones and a bleeding undercover cop. Every breath inside the shuttered mortuary smells of cordite, stale coffee, and drying arterial blood, forcing each survivor to weigh professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold out the crew.

actions.text: Hold Orange's head, whispering his final truth in the blood
Grab the satchel, Pink, and bolt through the side alley
Cut a cold professional truce before SWAT rams the door

observation.title: Joe Cabot's Finger on the Rat
observation.text: Joe Cabot strides into the mortuary warehouse like an aging king whose court has rotted, declares Mr. Blue dead, and levels his snub-nose revolver directly at bleeding Mr. Orange. Joe says the kid is a cop, one hundred percent certain, and tells White to step clear. Every breath inside the shuttered mortuary smells of cordite, stale coffee, and drying arterial blood, forcing each survivor to weigh professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold out the crew.

actions.text: Draw on Joe, swear Orange is solid, hold your nerve
Demand Joe prove how an undercover plant passed Eddie's vetting
Watch Pink slide behind the ramp with the Karina diamond satchel
Confront Orange directly with the rehearsed commode story tell

observation.title: Three Hammers Cocked in a Triangle
observation.text: Three heavy pistols lock into an impossible Mexican standoff: Joe aims down at Mr. Orange, Mr. White aims across at Joe's temple, and Nice Guy Eddie aims straight at White's chest, screaming for everybody to lower their iron before all three die on concrete. Shout Pink's name to broker a ten-second barrel drop
Drop aim half an inch to bargain Orange's life for the satchel
Back toward the drainage door with Pink while the Cabots freeze

observation.text: Gasoline slicks the concrete as Marvin Nash sobs, his uniform soaked. "I got a kid at home, I swear!" Mr. Blonde thumbs a chrome Zippo, the flame licking the damp air. Mr. Orange raises a trembling Smith & Wesson from the ramp, his gut wound pulsing. The shuttered mortuary reeks of cordite and stale coffee. Every breath tastes of betrayal. Orange’s finger hovers near the trigger, weighing professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold out the crew. The lighter clicks. The gun shakes. The silence stretches, thin as a razor, waiting for the next move.

actions.text: Empty the cylinder into Blonde's chest before the Zippo drops.
Wing Blonde's gun hand to keep him alive as a witness for Joe.
Hold fire until Nash blurts out the robbery-homicide unit name.

observation.title: Nash Gasps Through the Cordite
observation.text: Cordite and raw gasoline sting the air. Marvin Nash gasps through shock on the soaked floor, his wrists still bound. Mr. Orange bleeds from a gut wound, staring at the ceiling. Mr. White kneels, pressing a rag to the wound. Mr. Pink counts the diamonds in his pocket, his face unreadable. "If you talk, we all die," Pink says. "If you don't, Cabot walks," White counters. Nash's eyes dart to the shuttered door. The smell of stale coffee and drying blood fills the room. Every breath is a negotiation. The crew weighs professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold them out. The silence stretches, thick and dangerous.

actions.text: Swear Nash to silence and rehearse the Blonde-betrayal cover story
Stage the razor and gas can so Pink reads pure self-defense
Check Nash's cuffs and confess quietly when White bursts back in

observation.title: Nash Gasps Through the Cordite
observation.text: Cordite and raw gasoline sting the air. Marvin Nash gasps through shock on the soaked floor, his wrists still bound. Mr. Orange bleeds from a gut wound, staring at the ceiling. Mr. White kneels, pressing a rag to the wound. Mr. Pink counts the diamonds in his pocket, his face unreadable. "If you talk, we all die," Pink says. "If you don't, Cabot walks," White counters. Nash's eyes dart to the shuttered door. The smell of stale coffee and drying blood fills the room. Every breath is a negotiation. The crew weighs professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold them out. The silence stretches, thick and dangerous.

The silence stretches, thin as a razor, waiting for the next move.

observation.title: Nash Gasps Through the Cordite
observation.text: Cordite and raw gasoline sting the air. Marvin Nash gasps through shock on the soaked floor, his wrists still bound. Mr. Orange bleeds from a gut wound, staring at the ceiling. Mr. White kneels, pressing a rag to the wound. Mr. Pink counts the diamonds in his pocket, his face unreadable. "If you talk, we all die," Pink says. "If you don't, Cabot walks," White counters. Nash's eyes dart to the shuttered door. The smell of stale coffee and drying blood fills the room. Every breath is a negotiation. The crew weighs professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold them out. The silence stretches, thick and dangerous.

actions.text: Swear Nash to silence and rehearse the Blonde-betrayal cover story
Stage the razor and gas can so Pink reads pure self-defense
Check Nash's cuffs and confess quietly when White bursts back in

Mr. White kneels, pressing a rag to the wound. Mr. Pink counts the diamonds in his pocket, his face unreadable. "If you talk, we all die," Pink says. "If you don't, Cabot walks," White counters. Nash's eyes dart to the shuttered door. The smell of stale coffee and drying blood fills the room. Every breath is a negotiation. The crew weighs professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold them out. The silence stretches, thick and dangerous.

actions.text: Swear Nash to silence and rehearse the Blonde-betrayal cover story
Stage the razor and gas can so Pink reads pure self-defense
Check Nash's cuffs and confess quietly when White bursts back in

Orange swears Blonde planned to burn Nash, kill the crew, and steal the stones, while Eddie screams that Vic did four years for his father. Every breath inside the shuttered mortuary smells of cordite, stale coffee, and drying arterial blood, forcing each survivor to weigh professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold out the crew.

Inside the gunpowder haze, every lie told since breakfast at Uncle Bob's Pancake House comes due over a briefcase of stones and a bleeding undercover cop. Every breath inside the shuttered mortuary smells of cordite, stale coffee, and drying arterial blood, forcing each survivor to weigh professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold out the crew.

observation.title: Nash Gasps Through the Cordite
observation.text: Cordite and raw gasoline sting the air. Marvin Nash gasps through shock on the soaked floor, his wrists still bound. Mr. Orange bleeds from a gut wound, staring at the ceiling. Mr. White kneels, pressing a rag to the wound. Mr. Pink counts the diamonds in his pocket, his face unreadable. "If you talk, we all die," Pink says. "If you don't, Cabot walks," White counters. Nash's eyes dart to the shuttered door. The smell of stale coffee and drying blood fills the room. Every breath is a negotiation. The crew weighs professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold them out. The silence stretches, thick and dangerous.

actions.text: Swear Nash to silence and rehearse the Blonde-betrayal cover story
Stage the razor and gas can so Pink reads pure self-defense
Check Nash's cuffs and confess quietly when White bursts back in

Demand Joe prove how an undercover plant passed Eddie's vetting

Confront Orange directly with the rehearsed commode story tell

observation.title: Nash Gasps Through the Cordite
observation.text: Cordite and raw gasoline sting the air. Marvin Nash gasps through shock on the soaked floor, his wrists still bound. Mr. Orange bleeds from a gut wound, staring at the ceiling. Mr. White kneels, pressing a rag to the wound. Mr. Pink counts the diamonds in his pocket, his face unreadable. "If you talk, we all die," Pink says. "If you don't, Cabot walks," White counters. Nash's eyes dart to the shuttered door. The smell of stale coffee and drying blood fills the room. Every breath is a negotiation. The crew weighs professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold them out. The silence stretches, thick and dangerous.

Mr. White kneels, pressing a rag to the wound. Mr. Pink counts the diamonds in his pocket, his face unreadable. "If you talk, we all die," Pink says. "If you don't, Cabot walks," White counters. Nash's eyes dart to the shuttered door. The smell of stale coffee and drying blood fills the room. Every breath is a negotiation. The crew weighs professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold them out. The silence stretches, thick and dangerous.

actions.text: Swear Nash to silence and rehearse the Blonde-betrayal cover story
Stage the razor and gas can so Pink reads pure self-defense
Check Nash's cuffs and confess quietly when White bursts back in

observation.title: Vic Vega Was Family
observation.text: Mr. White, Mr. Pink, and Nice Guy Eddie return with the Karina diamond satchel to find gasoline pooling across the warehouse and Blonde down. Orange swears Blonde planned to burn Nash, kill the crew, and steal the stones, while Eddie screams that Vic did four years for his father. Every breath inside the shuttered mortuary smells of cordite, stale coffee, and drying arterial blood, forcing each survivor to weigh professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold out the crew.

actions.text: Blonde killed Karina's civilians, so Orange's story holds water
Pink's powder burn audit is neutral, so I side with him
Grab the diamond briefcase and test Orange's timeline slip

Inside the gunpowder haze, every lie told since breakfast at Uncle Bob's Pancake House comes due over a briefcase of stones and a bleeding undercover cop. Every breath inside the shuttered mortuary smells of cordite, stale coffee, and drying arterial blood, forcing each survivor to weigh professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold out the crew.

actions.text: Hold Orange's head, whispering his final truth in the blood
Grab the satchel, Pink, and bolt through the side alley
Cut a cold professional truce before SWAT rams the door

observation.title: Three Hammers Cocked in a Triangle
observation.text: Three heavy pistols lock into an impossible Mexican standoff: Joe aims down at Mr. Orange, Mr. White aims across at Joe's temple, and Nice Guy Eddie aims straight at White's chest, screaming for everybody to lower their iron before all three die on concrete. Every breath inside the shuttered mortuary smells of cordite, stale coffee, and drying arterial blood, forcing each survivor to weigh professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold out the crew.

actions.text: Keep your sights welded to Joe's head and refuse to blink
Shout Pink's name to broker a ten-second barrel drop
Drop aim half an inch to bargain Orange's life for the satchel
Back toward the drainage door with Pink while the Cabots freeze

observation.title: Nash Gasps Through the Cordite
observation.text: Cordite and raw gasoline sting the air. Marvin Nash gasps through shock on the soaked floor, his wrists still bound. Mr. Orange bleeds from a gut wound, staring at the ceiling. Mr. White kneels, pressing a rag to the wound. Mr. Pink counts the diamonds in his pocket, his face unreadable. "If you talk, we all die," Pink says. "If you don't, Cabot walks," White counters. Nash's eyes dart to the shuttered door. The smell of stale coffee and drying blood fills the room. Every breath is a negotiation. The crew weighs professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold them out. The silence stretches, thick and dangerous.

actions.text: Swear Nash to silence and rehearse the Blonde-betrayal cover story
Stage the razor and gas can so Pink reads pure self-defense
Check Nash's cuffs and confess quietly when White bursts back in

observation.title: Nash Gasps Through the Cordite
observation.text: Cordite and raw gasoline sting the air. Marvin Nash gasps through shock on the soaked floor, his wrists still bound. Mr. Orange bleeds from a gut wound, staring at the ceiling. Nash's eyes dart to the shuttered door. The smell of stale coffee and drying blood fills the room. Every breath is a negotiation. The crew weighs professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold them out. The silence stretches, thick and dangerous.

actions.text: Swear Nash to silence and rehearse the Blonde-betrayal cover story
Stage the razor and gas can so Pink reads pure self-defense
Check Nash's cuffs and confess quietly when White bursts back in

observation.text: Gasoline slicks the concrete as Marvin Nash sobs, his uniform soaked. "I got a kid at home, I swear!" Mr. Blonde thumbs a chrome Zippo, the flame licking the damp air. observation.title: Nash Gasps Through the Cordite
observation.text: Cordite and raw gasoline sting the air. Marvin Nash gasps through shock on the soaked floor, his wrists still bound. Mr. Orange bleeds from a gut wound, staring at the ceiling. Mr. White kneels, pressing a rag to the wound. Mr. Pink counts the diamonds in his pocket, his face unreadable. "If you talk, we all die," Pink says. "If you don't, Cabot walks," White counters. Nash's eyes dart to the shuttered door. The smell of stale coffee and drying blood fills the room. Every breath is a negotiation. The crew weighs professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold them out. The silence stretches, thick and dangerous.

observation.title: Vic Vega Was Family

observation.title: Nash Gasps Through the Cordite
observation.text: Cordite and raw gasoline sting the air. Marvin Nash gasps through shock on the soaked floor, his wrists still bound. Mr. Orange bleeds from a gut wound, staring at the ceiling. Mr. White kneels, pressing a rag to the wound. Mr. Pink counts the diamonds in his pocket, his face unreadable. "If you talk, we all die," Pink says. "If you don't, Cabot walks," White counters. Nash's eyes dart to the shuttered door. The smell of stale coffee and drying blood fills the room. Every breath is a negotiation. The crew weighs professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold them out. The silence stretches, thick and dangerous.

actions.text: Swear Nash to silence and rehearse the Blonde-betrayal cover story
Stage the razor and gas can so Pink reads pure self-defense
Check Nash's cuffs and confess quietly when White bursts back in

Every breath inside the shuttered mortuary smells of cordite, stale coffee, and drying arterial blood, forcing each survivor to weigh professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold out the crew.

actions.text: Keep your sights welded to Joe's head and refuse to blink
Shout Pink's name to broker a ten-second barrel drop
Drop aim half an inch to bargain Orange's life for the satchel
Back toward the drainage door with Pink while the Cabots freeze

observation.title: Nash Gasps Through the Cordite
observation.text: Cordite and raw gasoline sting the air. Marvin Nash gasps through shock on the soaked floor, his wrists still bound. Mr. Orange bleeds from a gut wound, staring at the ceiling. Mr. White kneels, pressing a rag to the wound. Mr. Pink counts the diamonds in his pocket, his face unreadable. "If you talk, we all die," Pink says. "If you don't, Cabot walks," White counters. Nash's eyes dart to the shuttered door. The smell of stale coffee and drying blood fills the room. Every breath is a negotiation. The crew weighs professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold them out. The silence stretches, thick and dangerous.

actions.text: Swear Nash to silence and rehearse the Blonde-betrayal cover story
Stage the razor and gas can so Pink reads pure self-defense
Check Nash's cuffs and confess quietly when White bursts back in

observation.title: Nash Gasps Through the Cordite
observation.text: Cordite and raw gasoline sting the air. Marvin Nash gasps through shock on the soaked floor, his wrists still bound. Mr. Orange bleeds from a gut wound, staring at the ceiling. Mr. White kneels, pressing a rag to the wound. Mr. Pink counts the diamonds in his pocket, his face unreadable. "If you talk, we all die," Pink says. "If you don't, Cabot walks," White counters. Nash's eyes dart to the shuttered door. The smell of stale coffee and drying blood fills the room. Every breath is a negotiation. The crew weighs professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold them out. The silence stretches, thick and dangerous.

Stage the razor and gas can so Pink reads pure self-defense
Check Nash's cuffs and confess quietly when White bursts back in

Joe says the kid is a cop, one hundred percent certain, and tells White to step clear. Every breath inside the shuttered mortuary smells of cordite, stale coffee, and drying arterial blood, forcing each survivor to weigh professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold out the crew.

observation.title: Nash Gasps Through the Cordite
observation.text: Cordite and raw gasoline sting the air. Marvin Nash gasps through shock on the soaked floor, his wrists still bound. Mr. Orange bleeds from a gut wound, staring at the ceiling. Mr. White kneels, pressing a rag to the wound. Mr. Pink counts the diamonds in his pocket, his face unreadable. "If you talk, we all die," Pink says. "If you don't, Cabot walks," White counters. Nash's eyes dart to the shuttered door. The smell of stale coffee and drying blood fills the room. Every breath is a negotiation. The crew weighs professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold them out. The silence stretches, thick and dangerous.

actions.text: Swear Nash to silence and rehearse the Blonde-betrayal cover story
Stage the razor and gas can so Pink reads pure self-defense
Check Nash's cuffs and confess quietly when White bursts back in

observation.title: Nash Gasps Through the Cordite
observation.text: Cordite and raw gasoline sting the air. Marvin Nash gasps through shock on the soaked floor, his wrists still bound. Mr. Orange bleeds from a gut wound, staring at the ceiling. Mr. White kneels, pressing a rag to the wound. Mr. Pink counts the diamonds in his pocket, his face unreadable. "If you talk, we all die," Pink says. "If you don't, Cabot walks," White counters. Nash's eyes dart to the shuttered door. The smell of stale coffee and drying blood fills the room. Every breath is a negotiation. The crew weighs professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold them out. The silence stretches, thick and dangerous.

actions.text: Swear Nash to silence and rehearse the Blonde-betrayal cover story
Stage the razor and gas can so Pink reads pure self-defense
Check Nash's cuffs and confess quietly when White bursts back in

Mr. Orange raises a trembling Smith & Wesson from the ramp, his gut wound pulsing. The shuttered mortuary reeks of cordite and stale coffee. Every breath tastes of betrayal. The silence stretches, thin as a razor, waiting for the next move.

observation.title: Nash Gasps Through the Cordite
observation.text: Cordite and raw gasoline sting the air. Marvin Nash gasps through shock on the soaked floor, his wrists still bound. Mr. Orange bleeds from a gut wound, staring at the ceiling. Mr. White kneels, pressing a rag to the wound. Mr. Pink counts the diamonds in his pocket, his face unreadable. "If you talk, we all die," Pink says. "If you don't, Cabot walks," White counters. Nash's eyes dart to the shuttered door. The smell of stale coffee and drying blood fills the room. Every breath is a negotiation. The crew weighs professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold them out. The silence stretches, thick and dangerous.

actions.text: Swear Nash to silence and rehearse the Blonde-betrayal cover story
Stage the razor and gas can so Pink reads pure self-defense
Check Nash's cuffs and confess quietly when White bursts back in

observation.title: Zippo, Blood, and the Ramp
observation.text: Gasoline slicks the concrete as Marvin Nash sobs, his uniform soaked. "I got a kid at home, I swear!" Mr. Blonde thumbs a chrome Zippo, the flame licking the damp air. Mr. Orange raises a trembling Smith & Wesson from the ramp, his gut wound pulsing. The shuttered mortuary reeks of cordite and stale coffee. Every breath tastes of betrayal. Orange’s finger hovers near the trigger, weighing professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold out the crew. The lighter clicks. The gun shakes. The silence stretches, thin as a razor, waiting for the next move.

actions.text: Empty the cylinder into Blonde's chest before the Zippo drops.

Hold fire until Nash blurts out the robbery-homicide unit name.

observation.title: Nash Gasps Through the Cordite
observation.text: Cordite and raw gasoline sting the air. Marvin Nash gasps through shock on the soaked floor, his wrists still bound. Mr. Orange bleeds from a gut wound, staring at the ceiling. Mr. White kneels, pressing a rag to the wound. Mr. Pink counts the diamonds in his pocket, his face unreadable. "If you talk, we all die," Pink says. "If you don't, Cabot walks," White counters. Nash's eyes dart to the shuttered door. The smell of stale coffee and drying blood fills the room. Every breath is a negotiation. The crew weighs professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold them out. The silence stretches, thick and dangerous.

actions.text: Swear Nash to silence and rehearse the Blonde-betrayal cover story
Stage the razor and gas can so Pink reads pure self-defense
Check Nash's cuffs and confess quietly when White bursts back in

observation.title: Sirens Outside the Mortuary Door
observation.text: Tires screech across gravel outside the corrugated steel door as LAPD bullhorns crackle down the block. Inside the gunpowder haze, every lie told since breakfast at Uncle Bob's Pancake House comes due over a briefcase of stones and a bleeding undercover cop. Every breath inside the shuttered mortuary smells of cordite, stale coffee, and drying arterial blood, forcing each survivor to weigh professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold out the crew.

actions.text: Hold Orange's head, whispering his final truth in the blood
Grab the satchel, Pink, and bolt through the side alley
Cut a cold professional truce before SWAT rams the door

observation.title: Zippo, Blood, and the Ramp
observation.text: Gasoline slicks the concrete as Marvin Nash sobs, his uniform soaked. "I got a kid at home, I swear!" Mr. Blonde thumbs a chrome Zippo, the flame licking the damp air. Orange’s finger hovers near the trigger, weighing professional discipline against the creeping certainty that an LAPD plant sold out the crew. The lighter clicks. The gun shakes. The silence stretches, thin as a razor, waiting for the next move.

actions.text: Empty the cylinder into Blonde's chest before the Zippo drops.
Wing Blonde's gun hand to keep him alive as a witness for Joe.
Hold fire until Nash blurts out the robbery-homicide unit name.
